desc_en: Subtle geometry meets elegance in motion. This design unites white, soft pink, and black with delicate gold-toned lines. The knotted back and posterior opening introduce a distinctive detail to a wide-strap, round-neck silhouette. Soft, elastic fabric accompanies every movement with absolute fluidity. Made-to-order piece available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Geometría sutil para una elegancia en movimiento. Este diseño combina blanco, rosa suave y negro con delicadas líneas de tono dorado. Su espalda anudada y la abertura posterior aportan un detalle distintivo a una silueta de tirantes anchos y escote redondo. El tejido suave y elástico acompaña cada movimiento con absoluta fluidez. Pieza hecha a medida con disponibilidad de envío mundial.
details_en:
· Composition: 80% polyester and 20% elastane.
· Back design: knotted band with back opening.
· Coverage: opaque pads.
· Print: geometric shapes and printed gold-toned lines without metallic finish.
· Care: hand wash or machine wash at a maximum of 45 °C. Do not bleach and avoid prolonged soaking.
· Made to order.
· Worldwide shipping available.
details_es:
